note: Synthetic data. Point estimates must match the R script exactly at the stated rounding; bootstrap CIs depend on each language's RNG and may differ slightly. Run python/check_agreement.py after r/analysis.R to add the 'r' values.
assumptions: Per-type corrected accuracy uses POOLED judge sensitivity/specificity: no question type has >= 30 truly-correct and >= 30 truly-wrong human grades, so per-type sens/spec would be too noisy. This assumes the judge's error rates do not differ by question type (true by construction here; check it in real data as the human sample grows).
Missing judge verdicts (timeouts) are treated as missing at random and excluded.
Bootstrap resamples question clusters (near-duplicates share a cluster), B = 2000, percentile CI.
Failure causes use observable traces (gold vs. retrieved docs, claim support); correctness from human grades.
